name: Klymax at Desa Potato Head
description: is a state-of-the-art underground nightclub in Bali, a collaboration between Potato Head and DJ Harvey, designed to prioritize an exceptional sound and dance experience. Located at Desa Potato Head, it features a custom-built sound system, acoustically treated interiors, and a sprung dancefloor, with events typically held on Friday and Saturday nights.
priceRange: Entry only on event nights — typically IDR 100.000–200.000 depending on lineup; VIP / table reservations price varies per event
